name: board_snapshot
protocol_phrase: The user prompt already includes a board_snapshot-style state summary; call `board_snapshot()` only if you need to reread or refresh the state.

name: legal_plays
protocol_phrase: Call `legal_plays()` before committing so you know the exact legal candidate domino_ids.

name: play_brief
protocol_phrase: Call `play_brief(play=X)` for each plausible legal candidate; note any catalyst dominoes and seats it names.

name: simulate_hand_impact
protocol_phrase: Call `simulate_hand_impact(play_id=X, seat='left_opp|partner|right_opp', holds=Y)` when a play brief names a catalyst or you need to test a concrete hidden-hand hypothesis.

name: belief_trajectory
protocol_phrase: Call `belief_trajectory()` when you need the broader posterior over unseen dominoes, not just one hypothesis.
